import Mathlib

/-!
# Rank-32 record #4239: exact finite arithmetic
The source model is y² + xy = x³ - A*x + B. These are point-membership,
nonsingularity and finite-reduction claims only, not Mordell–Weil theorems.
-/

set_option maxRecDepth 65536
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

namespace GRWTSK.NumberTheory.ArithmeticGeometry.EllipticCurves.Record4239

def A : ℤ := 28623928991398919165500467001947502452240040593445344054331428726899413
def B : ℤ := 1636638097022027963025086119463360482368875730889253334875693440181143871885452358966522018914326964558817

/-- Equation in the source model; no supplied group law. -/
def OnRecordModel (x y : ℚ) : Prop :=
  y ^ 2 + x * y = x ^ 3 - (A : ℚ) * x + (B : ℚ)

/-- An exact rational equation check, not a group-theoretic claim. -/
theorem points_on_record_model (i : Fin 32) :
    OnRecordModel (pointX i) (pointY i) := by
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [OnRecordModel, pointX, pointY, A, B]

/-- Discriminant formula using b₂=1, b₄=-2A, b₆=4B and b₈=B-A². -/
def recordDiscriminant : ℤ :=
  let b₂ : ℤ := 1
  let b₄ : ℤ := -2 * A
  let b₆ : ℤ := 4 * B
  let b₈ : ℤ := B - A ^ 2;
  -(b₂ ^ 2 * b₈) - 8 * b₄ ^ 3 - 27 * b₆ ^ 2 + 9 * b₂ * b₄ * b₆

theorem discriminant_ne_zero : recordDiscriminant ≠ 0 := by
  norm_num [recordDiscriminant, A, B]

/-- Count affine solutions over ZMod p and add the point at infinity. -/
def reducedPointCount (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] : ℕ :=
  1 + (Finset.univ.filter (fun xy : ZMod p × ZMod p =>
    xy.2 ^ 2 + xy.1 * xy.2 =
      xy.1 ^ 3 - (A : ZMod p) * xy.1 + (B : ZMod p))).card

theorem pointCount7 : reducedPointCount 7 = 13 := by decide
theorem pointCount19 : reducedPointCount 19 = 27 := by decide

theorem goodAt7 : recordDiscriminant % 7 ≠ 0 := by
  norm_num [recordDiscriminant, A, B]
theorem goodAt19 : recordDiscriminant % 19 ≠ 0 := by
  norm_num [recordDiscriminant, A, B]

theorem shortXInt_eq (i : Fin 32) :
    (shortXInt i : ℚ) = 36 * pointX i + 3 := by
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [shortXInt, pointX]
